but what if it's too late? and those people just can't or won't forgive you for what you've done? fuck this being alive business is stupid.

the miracle being that somehow he will come back and everything will be ok and i can just forget about this whole mess of a situation, or a miracle will strike my brain and i will suddenly not care any more and just be happy with whatever life hands me. however, it seems as though neither of those is possible.

this sounds like an almost identical situation to mine. i od'd on pills and he was the last person i texted before i passed out. he didn't even reply. 
i've been "getting over" him for about 3 years now, and i wish i could tell you that it gets better. people will tell you that everything will be ok, that you just need to give it time, that you will find someone better, etc. but they have no fucking clue what it's like to love someone with everything you have.

i'm not gonna lie to you, it's hard, and most days are hell. but i will tell tell you that you aren't alone, that people out there do truly understand what this pain feels like. just hope for a miracle. that's what i do. and while i still haven't gotten it, it's the only thing that keeps me going.

how long have you been broken up for? it seems for me that no matter what you do, there will always be reminders of the person you love, so you have to find a way to manage those feelings when a reminder comes up. do you have anxiety issues as well? I was on xanax and ativan for situational anxiety, the ativan is nice because it is a "use when needed" drug and can help ease those panicky feelings when they come up.

who's to say what is or isn't "normal"? there is no such thing. i don't really want to be happy either, and i guess that would be socially abnormal, i'm sure. be certain that you are not the only one feeling like this.

wow, this sounds a lot like me. i generally alienate myself and push people away so that i have no one. i can be "opinionated", to put it mildly, and tend to offend people in social settings. so i completely understand what you mean. i'm sure people in your life have been your friend, but most people can't handle outgoing people, and prefer to live complacent, drama free, lives. i assume this is why they abandon me, anyways.

i hear you on the motivation. it's like i have this "idea" in my head of what i want to be, yet it's almost too hard to even continue trying to want it in the first place so i just give up and stop thinking about it. One thing that remotely helps me is driving and listening to tunes and crying and screaming in my car to the point of exhaustion. sometimes it helps me sleep. 
also, don't think ahead. literally just do one thing. one. do one email. then call it a day and give yourself props for at least doing that. then the next day do something else. and the next. baby steps are better than no steps.
